basis: Hereditary cerebellar ataxia defines neurologic dysfunction.
Provisional skeletal syndrome assignment; the supplied record lacks a definition, informative ancestors or phenotypes to establish this eponym confidently.
Defining renal, cardiac and skeletal malformations; lung hypoplasia 80-99%. Cleft palate (80-99%) and callosal defects (30-79%) omitted under the four-axis cap.
Cutaneous smooth-muscle tumor arising in genital skin; its location does not make it a purely reproductive disease.
Pineal parenchymal neuroepithelial tumor arising within the central nervous system.
Neoplasm of skull bones; neural, orbital and sinus involvement varies by subtype and is not generalizable across the umbrella.
Childhood chorea, developmental delay and intellectual disability define a neurologic disorder.
Isolated failure of spermatogenesis causing azoospermia and infertility; no endocrine dysfunction or other axis involvement established.
Arenaviral hemorrhagic infection with thrombocytopenia; hepatic injury 80-99%, renal insufficiency 30-79%. Coma may reflect systemic illness; rash is transient.
Clonal marrow disorder with ineffective erythropoiesis, macrocytic anemia and abnormal megakaryocytes.
Hepatitis B virus infection targets the liver; extrahepatic disease is uncommon or separately diagnosed.
Immunodeficiency with defining cryptosporidial intestinal and biliary infection; bronchiectasis in 2/5 (40%) supports pulmonary involvement.
Syndromic intellectual disability; PDA and metatarsus adductus each annotated 80-99%. Recurrent infections and asthma do not establish intrinsic immune deficiency.
Disease localized to the sigmoid colon.
Hereditary syndrome defined by multiple bilateral papillary carcinomas arising in the kidneys.
Isolated growth hormone deficiency; short stature and delayed bone age reflect impaired growth rather than separate skeletal tissue damage.
Inherited predisposition specifically affecting blood and marrow neoplasia; occasional lymphoma or autoimmune diagnoses do not define the whole syndrome.
Adenocarcinoma arising in the urethra, which belongs to the urinary axis.
Broad umbrella for destructive skin and mucosal ulcers, commonly oral or digestive; ocular involvement belongs to a specific subtype.
Progressive sensorineural hearing loss and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy with QT prolongation jointly define the syndrome.
Carcinoma arising from cutaneous eccrine sweat glands.
Defining skin fragility, nail abnormalities, oral mucosal blistering and enamel hypoplasia; teeth and oral mucosa belong to gastrointestinal.
Malignant smooth-muscle soft-tissue tumor; an inflammatory infiltrate does not itself establish infection or immune-mediated disease.
Glutamine metabolism disorder defined by encephalopathy, seizures or spastic ataxia; respiratory failure does not establish direct pulmonary damage.
Optic atrophy; despite the isolated wording, leukoencephalopathy and developmental delay occur in 4/4, hearing impairment in 3/4. Splenomegaly alone does not establish dysfunction.
